semantics.clock: All state updates occur on the positive edge of clk.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset has priority and sets q to 32'h00000001 at each rising edge with reset high. Reset changes between edges do not change q.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state is specified; defined sequence begins after a reset clock edge.
semantics.transition: On each rising edge with reset low, use the old q: next_q = (q >> 1) XOR (q[0] ? 32'h80200003 : 32'h00000000). Taps numbered 32,22,2,1 correspond to q indices 31,21,1,0. Thus next_q[31]=q[0], next_q[21]=q[22]^q[0], next_q[1]=q[2]^q[0], next_q[0]=q[1]^q[0]; all remaining bits shift right unchanged.
semantics.between_edges: q retains its registered state; no enable or additional interface exists.

numeric.operations: Logical right shift with zero fill and bitwise XOR over GF(2); no signed arithmetic, saturation, rounding, or arithmetic carries.
numeric.feedback: All tapped bits use the same pre-edge least significant bit.

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit reference recurrence: for indices 0 through 30 copy old bit i+1, XOR old bit 0 only for indices 21,1,0, and set index 31 to old bit 0.
checks: Reset seed and held reset across multiple edges
Compare 4096 consecutive transitions against per-bit reference
Assert reset between edges and confirm state is unchanged until next rising edge
Check state remains unchanged between rising edges
